covers: JSE session and SA data to 14:34 SAST, Wednesday 11 November 2026
headline: Baird downgrades Nvidia; JSE All Share falls further to 113,984 as Woolworths slides 7.9%; Nasdaq futures firmer on CoreWeave
summary: The JSE All Share fell to 113,983.77 at 14:34 SAST, 0.6% below Tuesday's 114,693.44 close, with Woolworths down 7.9% at R38.03 after a weak sales update and Naspers (-2.6%) and Prosus (-2.5%) still the main drag; the rand held at R16.55/$ (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner quotes from Yahoo Finance, 11 Nov 14:17-14:34 SAST). In the US, a CNBC headline says Baird has downgraded Nvidia over worries about CEO Jensen Huang and AI uncertainty, even as Nasdaq futures rose on CoreWeave's results (CNBC headlines, 11 Nov). Gold eased to $4,053.10 and Brent rose to $93.25, with the US 10-year yield near 5% after Tuesday's hot inflation data still the main pressure on gold, the rand and emerging-market shares (LRC Market Dashboard, 11 Nov 14:34 SAST).

items.title: Woolworths shares fall 7.9% as sales stall
items.summary: Woolworths Holdings traded at R38.03 at 14:17 SAST, down 7.9% on the day and lower than at midday (LRC Stock Scanner quotes from Yahoo Finance, 11 Nov 2026). A headline on thenational.co.za says sales have stalled as cash-strapped shoppers cut back. We could not open the article or the company's update to confirm the sales figures, so none are given here. Woolworths is not on our coverage list.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 14:17 SAST; thenational.co.za headline, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: US shares close lower and the 10-year yield ends at 4.98% after the inflation surprise
items.summary: The S&P 500 closed at 7,520.93 and the Nasdaq at 25,065.88 on Tuesday, both lower on the day according to a MarketWatch headline. The US 10-year Treasury yield closed at 4.98%. October consumer prices rose 0.4% (0.3% expected) and core prices 0.3% (0.2% expected), and CNBC headlines say this and comments from Fed Governor Waller have raised expectations of a Fed rate hike.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 close; LRC Macro Desk (BLS), 10 Nov 2026; CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 10 Nov 2026

items.title: Goldman Sachs changes its Fed rate forecast after the hot inflation data
items.summary: MarketWatch reports that Goldman Sachs is changing its Federal Reserve interest-rate forecast after Tuesday's October consumer-price data, and Investing.com headlines say bets on a Fed rate hike have risen. We could not open the articles to confirm what Goldman now expects, so no figures are given.

items.title: Nasdaq futures jump as CoreWeave's results lift tech
items.summary: CNBC's live page was headlined 'Nasdaq futures jump as CoreWeave earnings beat drives global tech rebound' at 13:29 SAST on Wednesday, after Tuesday's Nvidia-led fall. We could not open the page to confirm the size of the moves, so no figures are given. Wall Street opens at 16:30 SAST.

items.title: CoreWeave shares up about 11% after raising guidance
items.summary: A CNBC headline says CoreWeave's shares rose 11% after the AI cloud company lifted its outlook, easing concerns about an AI spending slowdown; MarketWatch adds that a new financing plan has eased worries about its debt. The stock closed Tuesday at $48.73 before the results (LRC Stock Scanner quotes from Yahoo Finance). We could not open the articles for the detailed figures.
items.source: CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 11 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 close

items.title: Alibaba plans to list its T-Head chip unit
items.summary: Alibaba announced plans to list T-Head, which CNBC describes as a rival to Nvidia in chips.

items.title: Retail monitor shows US shoppers under strain but still spending
items.summary: A CNBC headline on the CNBC/NRF Retail Monitor for October says consumers are showing signs of strain even as they keep spending. We could not open the article for the figures. Official US retail sales data is not covered here.

items.title: Unemployment rate rises to 33.7% in the third quarter
items.summary: Stats SA's QLFS showed the official unemployment rate up 0.1 percentage point to 33.7% in Q3 2026 from 33.6% in Q2. Employment rose by 101,000 to 16.8 million and formal-sector jobs by 268,000, but the number of unemployed also rose, by 97,000 to 8.6 million, as more people entered the labour force. The expanded (LU3) measure rose to 44.0%; youth unemployment eased to 47.3%. Released Tuesday 10 November (SAnews).

items.title: JSE All Share falls to 113,984; Naspers and Prosus down about 2.5%
items.summary: At 14:34 SAST on Wednesday the JSE All Share stood at 113,983.77 and the Top 40 at 106,086.82, down about 0.6% from Tuesday's closes of 114,693.44 and 106,738.05 after a firmer start (114,846 at 10:27). Naspers was at R757.73 (-2.6%) and Prosus at R681.42 (-2.5%) at 14:18 SAST, while Glencore (+1.1%) and BHP (+1.0%) were firmer (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner quotes from Yahoo Finance).
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 14:18-14:34 SAST

items.title: New fuel prices take effect today
items.summary: Adjusted petrol and diesel prices apply from Wednesday 11 November. IOL reports that part of the relief from lower oil prices is taken up by the new 'Slate levy'; we could not open the article to confirm the cents-per-litre changes, so they are left out.

items.title: Nersa admits electricity tariffs in three metros are unlawful
items.summary: Moneyweb reports the energy regulator has conceded that tariffs in three metros were unlawful. Details to follow once the article can be checked.

items.title: Dipula lifts its full-year dividend
items.summary: Moneyweb reports the property group raised its full-year dividend as earnings rose. Its shares were at R7.45, up 3.5%, at 14:10 SAST (LRC Stock Scanner quotes from Yahoo Finance). We could not open the article for the dividend figures.
items.source: Moneyweb headline, 11 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 14:10 SAST

items.title: Rand R16.55/$, R18.43/€, R22.03/£
items.summary: At 14:34 SAST on Wednesday the rand was at R16.55/$, R18.43/€ and R22.03/£, little changed through the day despite the firmer dollar after the US inflation data (LRC Market Dashboard from Yahoo Finance data, 11 Nov 2026).
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 14:34 SAST

items.title: Gold $4,053.10; platinum $1,563.30
items.summary: Gold fell on Tuesday as yields and the dollar rose after the inflation data, closing at $4,055.70. By 14:34 SAST on Wednesday it was at $4,053.10 and platinum at $1,563.30 (LRC Market Dashboard from Yahoo Finance); a Yahoo Finance headline says gold is falling back as inflation concerns broaden. An Exchange Rates UK headline reports Goldman Sachs has cut its 12-month gold target to $4,700; we could not open that article to confirm it.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 14:34 SAST; Yahoo Finance and Exchange Rates UK headlines, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: Brent $93.25; copper about $13,870/t
items.summary: Brent dipped briefly below $90 on Tuesday for the first time since August on Iran peace hopes and closed at $92.47. At 14:34 SAST on Wednesday it was at $93.25 and copper at about $13,870 a tonne (LRC Market Dashboard from Yahoo Finance). An Investing.com headline says oil is up 1% after Iran said no nuclear material will leave the country, with attacks on ships near Hormuz also offsetting truce hopes.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 10-11 Nov 2026 14:34 SAST; Investing.com headlines, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia: Baird downgrades the stock on CEO worries
items.summary: A CNBC headline at 14:25 SAST says Baird has downgraded Nvidia on worries about CEO Jensen Huang and uncertainty over AI spending; we could not open the article for the new rating or price target. A MarketWatch headline says Nvidia's valuation has fallen to a 15-year low. Earlier, CNBC reported the shares rebounding about 5% before the US open after Tuesday's 5.5% fall to $168.89 (LRC Stock Scanner quotes from Yahoo Finance). Results are due on 17 November. Our BUY rating and fair value of $262.56 (LRC Watchlist) are unchanged; a broker downgrade does not change our rating, and the price is well below that fair value.
items.source: CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 11 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 10 Nov 2026 close; LRC Watchlist

items.title: AMD gives back gains
items.summary: MarketWatch reports AMD's shares faded on Tuesday as investors weighed whether Nvidia's troubles will bring lasting gains for AMD. Our SELL rating is unchanged.
